variants.title: 01 无箭头 · 紧凑
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished, flat, high fidelity dark UI design screenshot, a redesign of the activity EDIT FORM card in the reference image. Reference image is for business content and palette only. Show a single centered compact card on a plain almost-black background, landscape image, card occupies most of image width. This is a DATA ENTRY FORM, not a statistics card. Keep only group caption 第3组, a small blue ab-wheel exercise pictogram tile, activity name 健腹轮, one clearly visible quantity input field, and save action 保存. Absolutely NO numeral zero, NO unit 次 anywhere, NO giant numbers, NO statistics, NO new business features. Text in activity name, input, and save button must have exactly the SAME font size and normal/medium weight, about 16px at a realistic 390px card width; group caption 14px and muted. Compact 20px card padding, 12–16px gaps, modest 16px corner radius, minimum 44px touch targets. Input has a darker inset fill and a visible thin gray border, subtle 8px radius; placeholder 数量 in muted gray when empty. Original dark charcoal card and restrained solid blue save button; pictogram blue on muted navy. No large heading inside product UI. Add only the variant number and short Chinese concept label ABOVE and OUTSIDE the card, small neutral typography. No device frame, perspective, glossy effects, gradients, decorative textures, or huge whitespace. Render Chinese text precisely.
Variant label: 01 无箭头 · 紧凑
Layout: Two-row compact form beneath group caption. Main row: small 36px exercise tile, plain activity name 健腹轮 with absolutely NO chevron or arrow beside it; on far right a 90px wide 44px high EMPTY bordered input with placeholder 数量. Lower row: compact blue 保存 button at bottom right, about 76px by 40px. No separator. Overall card height about 180px at 390px width. The activity name is visually clean and clickable without a bordered field.
